meta.title: LDC (Lower Deduction Certificate) Handling: not available on the Growth plan
gaps: The LDC Handling capability and its automatic application during TDS computation cannot be opened or asserted.
Comparing availability between Growth and Enterprise plan tenants cannot be performed because no plan-tier or unnamed-tenant switching step exists.
Signing in as an AP Executive and repeating the workflow across both tenants cannot be automated by the catalog.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: The LDC Handling capability and its automatic application during TDS computation cannot be opened or asserted.; Comparing availability between Growth and Enterprise plan tenants cannot be performed because no plan-tier or unnamed-tenant switching step exists.; Signing in as an AP Executive and repeating the workflow across both tenants cannot be automated by the catalog.

args.need: sign in as an AP Executive, verify that LDC Handling is unavailable on the Growth-plan tenant, then repeat the same workflow on an Enterprise-plan tenant and verify that LDC Handling is available and applies vendor LDCs automatically during TDS computation

steps.note: The catalog has no LDC workflow, plan comparison, or AP Executive session step, so tester intervention is required for the complete subject.
Check that the session remains free of application errors after the tester completes the requested comparison; this does not substitute for the missing LDC assertions.
